factor_design.comparison_pairing: all arms within a combination share trunk, initialization, masks, and loader seed

estimands.named_donor: A1500+B750 versus A1500 on held-out recipient donors
estimands.additional_recipient_control: A1500+B750 versus A2250 on held-out recipient donors

decision_gates.raw_addition_viable_branch: At least three of eight edges are stable helpful. Proceed to larger confirmation and directed predictor testing.
decision_gates.reproducible_but_not_helpful_branch: At least six of eight edges have stable signs but fewer than three are helpful. Pivot raw addition toward negative-transfer avoidance or selective-sharing architectures.
decision_gates.unstable_branch: Fewer than six edges have stable signs. Treat optimization stability as the bottleneck; test one recipient-protected sharing implementation before deciding whether to pivot.

bootstrap.unit: crossed trunk seed, optimization seed, and held-out GTEx donor

claim_boundary: This post-discovery diagnosis can separate frozen-trunk dependence from optimization-seed instability on donor-disjoint GTEx development data. It cannot rescue the preliminary eight-edge result, select a best seed, establish study universality, or confirm biological mechanism.
